scope.scannerPackageSet: Package, lockfile, and source indicators for pre-execution review.
scope.currentCampaignContext: OX Security reported a DPRK-linked npm infostealer/RAT campaign involving terminal-logger-utils and dependent packages pretty-logger-utils, ts-logger-pack, and pinno-loggers. GitHub Advisory GHSA-m3gw-x6rc-fp3r reports csc154-internall-depend as npm malware with all versions affected. This checker detects those package names and selected behavior indicators.
